card.name: Verbs after animal study descriptions
card.fires_on: The past participle (done, conducted, performed) right after 'studies were' or 'study' in animal reproduction and toxicity sections. Also a few similar verbs like 'used' in 'Caution should be used'.

modes.label: Studies were done
modes.description: Verb after 'studies/study were' in teratogenicity or reproduction study statements.
modes.example: Reproduction studies were<< performed>> to evaluate general reproductive performance and fertility in

modes.label: Study conducted in animals
modes.description: Participle right after a noun like study or studies, leading into the species tested.
modes.example: A 2-year carcinogenicity study<< conducted>> in mice employing diclofenac sodium

card.writes: It pushes toward rare name pieces and Chinese words and away from Chinese 'toward' words, so the output effect is unclear.
card.plain: It lights up on the verb that says a study was carried out, as in animal reproduction study statements.
